title: Dream on hold for Bunbury surfers
what_it_shows: ABC News video segment on the Airwave inflatable surf reef tearing during its December 2019 installation attempt at Bunbury Back Beach: an aerial/drone shot of the inflated bladder sitting on the seabed with a diver and marker buoy nearby, then a beachfront vox-pop interview with touring surfer Camille-Audrey Perron at the Back Beach access point. Confirmed on-site (Bunbury Back Beach) by the visible surf-club mural and access-point signage matching other Back Beach photos, and by the named interviewee matching the companion ABC article [R1].
key_quotes: 00:03 — aerial shot shows the inflated Airwave bladder on the seabed off Bunbury Back Beach with a diver alongside it
00:12 (approx) — on-screen lower third identifies interviewee 'Camille-Audrey Perron, Touring Surfer', consistent with the 'tourist Perron' quoted in the companion ABC article [R1]

Bottegal (installer/inventor), on cause per companion article: "We had a lot of undertow — a new swell came through that was a very deep swell that we weren't planning on, and it was pushing the undertow through the line-up." [R1]
